groups.note: mean/min of member scores; charts and funnel limits only for groups of at least 3 scored companies

alerts.note: two-sided score alerts, category drops, going dark, top customer quiet; onsets only

forecast.note: method shipped: reversion_quantile; fan skill over the naive fan at 3 months +8.5% (cross-validated, train companies); no seasonality found (tested)

owners_actions.note: Alert.owner and Alert.action are filled by analysis/monitor/routing.py

counterparty_entities.note: customers/suppliers only if counterparty IDs map to company IDs; they do not today

seasonality.note: 24 months give one lap and a bit: this can rule out a strong yearly pattern, not a weak one.

items.label: Días de pago tras el vencimiento (proveedores)
items.why: Own payment behaviour is the closest analogue of FICO payment history. Amount-weighted days between due and payment on invoices paid in the trailing 3 months (e_delay_coll/e_delay_paid construction), averaged over 3 months.

items.label: Días que tardan los clientes en pagar tras el vencimiento
items.why: Collections lateness drives liquidity stress. Same construction on the receivables side.

items.label: Pagos a proveedores con más de 30 días de retraso
items.why: Share of open payables more than 30 days past due (Banque de France: only > 30 days moves default risk).

items.label: Cobros de clientes con más de 30 días de retraso
items.why: Share of open receivables more than 30 days past due.

items.label: Meses de salidas cubiertos por la caja
items.why: Period-end cash / mean monthly operating outflow (6-month, 3-month when the trail is shorter), clipped -6..24, averaged over 3 months. The 6-month denominator makes it slow to react to a one-quarter outflow collapse.

items.label: Cierres de mes con caja negativa
items.why: Share of the last 3 month-ends with cash < 0 (recomputed from cash rounded to cents; the store's flag has float noise at zero).

items.label: Veces que la caja pasó a negativo
items.why: Onsets of negative cash in the last 6 month-ends.

items.label: Pago de deuda / entradas de caja
items.why: 3-month debt repayment over 3-month operating inflow (f_ds_r), averaged over 3 months. Debt load, the analogue of amounts owed.

items.label: Comisiones e intereses bancarios / entradas de caja
items.why: 3-month fees + interest over 3-month operating inflow (f_fc_r), averaged over 3 months.

items.label: Meses de historial
items.why: Fixed mapping: 100 x min(months observed, 12) / 12. A thin file is less certain; the confidence flag says so too.

items.label: Meses con entrada de dinero
items.why: Fixed mapping: 100 x share of the last 6 months with any incoming movement. Guard item: a company that goes dark loses points here.

items.label: Volatilidad de las salidas
items.why: Std / mean of monthly operating outflows over 6 months (a_out_vol, clip 3). A company trait (night: 74% between-company variance), fine for a level score.

items.label: Pago de deuda al alza
items.why: Rise of debt service / inflows vs the same window 6 months earlier (0 if it fell). Facility counts are excluded: connection dates make them rise with time.

items.label: Comisiones e intereses al alza
items.why: Rise of fees + interest / inflows vs the same window 6 months earlier (0 if it fell).

items.label: Dependencia de un solo cliente
items.why: Customer HHI above 0.975 only (night: the body of the distribution is noise, the one-buyer tail is not), 3-month mean.

items.label: Notas de crédito / facturación
items.why: Share of billing reversed by credit notes, 3-month mean. Experimental: no paper measures it.

disclaimer: Documented, explainable score computed from the company's own treasury trail. It is a monitoring aid, not a bankruptcy predictor: on the accepted outcomes it does not beat a company-size baseline (product/score/validation.md).
